title: Recycling Rate Targets by Waste Type
what_it_is: Recycling Rate Targets by Waste Type

sections.label: Zero Waste Masterplan recycling targets
sections.summary: The Zero Waste Masterplan sets a 70% national recycling rate target by 2030, with 30% domestic and 81% non-domestic targets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under the Zero Waste Masterplan, we have set a target to achieve a national recycling rate of 70% by 2030, which is supported by targets to increase the domestic recycling rate to 30% by 2030 and the non-domestic recycling rate to 81% by 2030.

sections.label: Beverage container return scheme
sections.summary: The upcoming beverage container return scheme, expected by mid-2024, encourages recycling of containers like plastic bottles and chemical recycling is one initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Members of the public will have more opportunities to contribute to plastics recycling under the upcoming beverage container return scheme, which will encourage the return and recycling of beverage containers, such as plastic bottles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This scheme is expected to be in place by mid-2024 and will help cultivate recycling habits amongst the community and enable us to aggregate clean and high-quality recyclables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Similar schemes in countries, such as Norway, Sweden and Lithuania, have achieved return rates of 80% or higher.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: One such initiative is chemical recycling which can process plastics that cannot be mechanically recycled, such as contaminated single-use plastics, and convert these into feedstock to manufacture new products like plastics, chemicals and even sustainable aviation fuels.

sections.label: Zero Waste Masterplan recycling rates
sections.summary: The Zero Waste Masterplan has an overall recycling rate target of 70%, with domestic 30% and non-domestic 81% targets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: My reply is, firstly, that under our Zero Waste Masterplan, we have an overall recycling rate target of 70%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is accompanied by a domestic recycling target rate of 30% and a non-domestic target recycling rate of 81%.

sections.label: E-waste and beverage container targets
sections.summary: E-waste has collection targets of 60% for large appliances and 20% for others, and stakeholders are consulted on beverage container return rates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For e-waste, for instance, there is a collection target of 60% for large household appliances and 20% for the rest of the covered products.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Similarly, for the beverage container return scheme, in countries that have implemented it, they have achieved collection or return rates of 80% and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are, currently, consulting the relevant stakeholders to determine the target return rates that we will set for the Beverage Container Return Scheme.
